svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: iOS · Gallery · Library sheet · portrait
svg.desc: Mirrors App/GalleryView.swift (compact branch — the .sheet(isPresented: $showSidebarSheet) block, which wraps App/GallerySidebar.swift in a NavigationStack titled "Library" with a "Done" confirmationAction) as shipped on 2026-09-11, code first, mirrored from the running app. THE SHEET the ▤ Library button in gallery.portrait.svg's compact header raises on an iPhone; on iPad and Mac the same GallerySidebar is the fixed 200pt pane in macOS/gallery.svg instead. It rises over the dimmed Gallery — the parent's top edge (#D5D5D9, x 17, 359 wide, rx 10) peeks 10pt above it, right under the status bar — with a 10pt corner radius, LL.screenBackground, "Done" 17pt semibold in LL.accent trailing 16 (baseline 103), and the large title "Library" 34pt bold 16 in (baseline 160). BELOW IT, GallerySidebar's own ScrollView: VStack(spacing 20) of four sections, a hairline Divider between each pair (.padding(.horizontal, 12) → x 12–381), .padding(.top, 14). Every section header is LLSectionHeader — 13pt semibold, kerning 0.5, secondary, uppercased — 18pt in (the sidebar's 14 + the header's own 4). LIBRARY: the four CaptureFilter.withoutScans rows drawn by LibraryFilterRow — HStack(spacing 10) of a 14pt-medium SF Symbol in a 20pt-wide frame (centred at x 28) and the 14pt label (x 48), .padding(.horizontal, 14) .padding(.vertical, 7) inside a further .padding(.horizontal, 4), VStack spacing 2 — square.grid.2x2 "All", photo "Photos", square.stack "Interval", film "Video". All is the selected filter here, so its row draws the selected state: LL.accent @ 10% RoundedRectangle(8) spanning x 4–389 by 31pt (y 208.5–239.5), accent glyph, accent label. The others: secondary glyph, primary label, no capsule. Rows nominally pitch 33 (31 + 2); measured 33 / 34.7 / 33.6 — see the note at the end. TAGS: present only when the visible library carries any scene tag (`if !presentTags.isEmpty`) — three here, Urban · People · Vehicles, from allCaptures.presentSceneTags through SceneMetadata.label. Each row is a 7pt Circle (primary @ 25% at rest, LL.accent when on) at x 14, spacing 10, then the 14pt label at x 31, .padding(.horizontal, 14) .padding(.vertical, 6), VStack spacing 2 → pitch 31 (baselines 423 · 454 · 485). Tags are cumulative (a project must carry every lit tag); while any is lit a 12pt medium LL.accent "Clear tags" link sits 14pt in, 2pt under the last row (not drawn — none lit). COLLECTIONS: one LibraryFilterRow, rectangle.stack "All Collections", never selected — it is not a filter but a door: it sets model.requestedTab = .collections. It does NOT dismiss this sheet (nothing writes showSidebarSheet = false on that path), so on an iPhone the tab switches underneath and the person finds Collections when they tap Done — noted as shipped, not changed here. SHAPES (new, 2026-09-11 — GallerySidebar.shapesSection over ShapeFilter.allCases and AppModel.shapeSummaries, refreshed onAppear by model.refreshShapeSummaries()): four LibraryFilterRows in the register's vocabulary — oval "Ellipse", rectangle "Rectangle", square "Square", circle.slash "No Shapes" — drawn at rest here, none lit (glyph centres y 659.5 · 692.5 · 725.5 · 759.5, label baselines 664 · 697 · 730 · 764). A project shows under Ellipse / Rectangle / Square when its shapes.json register (written by Create ▸ Shape-mation ▸ Find shapes, or by a shape drawn in the photo editor's Masks tab) holds one of that family, and under No Shapes when the register is empty or was never written — so the pictures the detector missed can be browsed to and given a shape by hand. All four rows are always offered: an empty row is the prompt to run Find shapes, not a dead control. A LIT ROW draws exactly like All above — LL.accent @ 10% capsule x 4–389 × 31 rx 8, accent glyph, accent label. Rows narrow like the tag rows: a project must hold EVERY lit shape (Set<ShapeFilter>.toggle). No Shapes is exclusive — lighting it clears the three families and lighting a family clears it — and means an empty register or none at all. While any shape row is lit a 12pt medium LL.accent "Clear shapes" link sits 14pt in, 4pt under the last row, exactly as "Clear tags" does under the tags (neither link is drawn — the rest state has nothing to clear). And the ▤ Library button in the Gallery header behind this sheet lights LL.accent whenever a shape row is lit, the same as when the kind filter or a tag narrows the library (GalleryView.libraryButton: isLit = filter != .all || !query.tags.isEmpty || !shapeSelection.isEmpty). Bottom: the ScrollView's .padding(.bottom, 20); the sheet has no tab bar. STATES NOT DRAWN: a lit tag or shape row and its Clear link; a library with no tags (the TAGS section and its divider vanish and COLLECTIONS moves up); the sheet's own scrolled state (this content fits at rest). HOOKS: LL_TAB=gallery brings the tab front; LL_SHAPES=ellipse,rectangle,square,empty (any subset) seeds the lit shape rows for screenshots; there is no hook that opens this sheet — it is one tap on ▤. MEASURED from Steven's iPhone 16 Pro screenshot (1206×2622 px = 402×874 pt @3×, not the 393×852 canvas): leading and trailing insets are kept as measured, so row capsules and dividers are 9pt shorter here; the sheet's top edge sat at 72 there (status bar 62 + 10) and is drawn at 69 on this canvas (status bar 59 + 10) — the 56 in manage-presets.portrait.svg, this file's template, was drawn design-first and never measured against a device. One shipped rhythm quirk, drawn as measured: LibraryFilterRow fixes the symbol's WIDTH at 20 but not its height, so rows whose symbol is taller than the 17pt text line (square.stack, film) run 1–2pt taller than the 31pt text rows — the LIBRARY rows pitch 33 / 34.7 / 33.6 rather than an even 33. **2026-09-15 — a VIEW section on top:** the Timeline switch (GallerySidebar.viewSection, drawn only when the sidebar is this sheet — GalleryView passes `$timelineMode`; the wide layouts pass nothing and keep the Timeline button in their header row). It is here because the portrait header's Timeline glyph gave its seat to the sync pill (gallery.portrait.svg) and the mode is remembered across launches — without a switch a phone would be trapped in whichever mode it last set elsewhere. Toggle tinted LL.accent, calendar glyph secondary at rest and accent while on, "Timeline" 14pt, a 12pt caption "Tiles grouped by shoot day, with a month rail", a divider, then LIBRARY as before — everything below moved down 105.5, so SHAPES now runs under the fold and the sheet scrolls (the "fits at rest" note above no longer holds). Verified on the iPhone 16 Pro simulator (iOS 18.6) 2026-09-15: the switch reads the remembered mode (drawn on when `-gallery.timelineMode YES` is passed) and the grid follows it; the simulator tool cannot flip a UISwitch by a synthesized tap, so the flip itself was not driven — it is the same `$timelineMode` binding the wide header's Toggle writes. **2026-09-26 — a PICPLACE section** (connected asset states plan §14, its glyphs in §16's status-glyph scheme, signed off on the canvas "Holdings Pill States" rev. 2; code 0917df0 + b559c96; mirrored from the code and the devices' own LL_PILL_SHEET=1 renders, whose bottom row is these glyphs — no simulator run). In a library CONNECTED to PicPlace GalleryView hands GallerySidebar `picplaceFilter` (only while model.picplace.binding != nil — a standalone library has no section at all, and the filter falls back to All) and the sidebar draws `picplaceSection` directly under LIBRARY, behind its own Divider and before TAGS (so between Library and Collections): LLSectionHeader("PicPlace") — uppercased, PICPLACE — then seven LibraryFilterRows over PicPlaceFilter.allCases in the brief's words: All · On this device · Download available · Not available to download · Needs uploading · Has blends · Syncing / Needs attention. Each row's glyph is its state's own (PicPlaceFilter.statusGlyph → StatusGlyphView, 13 pt semibold, light palette) in the 20 pt column centred on x 28 — "a filter looks like the tiles it keeps": square.grid.2x2 neutral #48484A (All, a plain symbol) · camera.fill green #248A3D (On this device — green means here, nothing else) · camera.fill grey #AEAEB2 (Download available — on PicPlace) · the grey camera with a slash knocked through (Not available to download — nowhere reachable; SF Symbols has no slashed camera) · icloud.and.arrow.up.fill neutral #48484A with the arrow knocked out (Needs uploading) · square.3.layers.3d OUTLINE neutral (Has blends — HoldingsPillBody.blendsGlyph, the pill's layers as a plain symbol) · icloud.and.arrow.up.fill amber, LL.accent #C36A00 on a light list (Syncing / Needs attention — a transfer, a fresh upload PicPlace is still reading back, a failure or a conflict). Paths are the pill's 24-grid ones (components/holdings-pill.make.py) scaled to the devices' measured ink at 13 pt (camera ≈ 15.8 wide, cloud ≈ 16.4, grid ≈ 12.1); knock-outs are painted in the sheet's ground #F2F2F7 (a mask under a scale rasterizes coarsely in Quick Look). The glyphs keep their colours when a row is selected — selection is the label (LL.accent) and the row's accent @ 10 % capsule — so at rest BOTH All rows are lit, LIBRARY's and PICPLACE's, the two filters' defaults. The label is 14 pt at x 48 and wraps rather than truncating (`fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)` — the Mac's 200 pt column is where "Not available to download" wraps; at this width its 166 pt fits one line); the count is trailing at x 375 (4 + 14 in), 12 pt monospaced digits, secondary — how many of what the kind, tags, words and shapes leave each filter keeps (AppModel.picplaceCounts(for: listQuery)); All shows none. Representative counts for a 300-project library, the one gallery.portrait.svg's grid draws: On this device 287 · Download available 11 · Not available to download 2 (the first three partition the library) · Needs uploading 193 (originals here, not backed up, not being checked) · Has blends 42 · Syncing / Needs attention 1 (the grid's newest interval, uploaded and still being read back — a check counts as syncing, never as needing an upload). Geometry: the kind rows' — 31 pt rows at a 33 pt pitch, header baseline 394.5 → rows from 400 (in the section's frame, +105.5 on screen) — with one change under it: since 0917df0 every LibraryFilterRow is an HStack(alignment: .firstTextBaseline), the glyph sitting on the label's baseline rather than centred on the row; the status glyphs are drawn so (centre ≈ baseline − 4.6), and the LIBRARY / COLLECTIONS / SHAPES rows above and below are not re-measured — the shift is under a point for their symbols. While the status sweep runs (the first look at a connected library, then only what moved) an 11 pt secondary "Checking N of M projects…" sits at x 18, 4 pt under the last row — not drawn, at rest. ▤ in the Gallery header lights while a PicPlace filter other than All is on, as for a kind, a tag or a shape. The section and its divider are 288 pt deep: TAGS, COLLECTIONS and SHAPES move down by 288 (the nested translate), so the screen edge now catches the sheet at TAGS — the sheet is the default large one (no presentationDetents) and GallerySidebar's ScrollView scrolls the rest. HOOKS: `LL_SIDEBAR=1` now raises this sheet from launch on a phone (0.8 s late — a sheet raised in the tab's first pass is dropped), which supersedes "there is no hook that opens this sheet" above; `LL_PICPLACE_FILTER=onDevice|downloadAvailable|notAvailable|needsUploading|hasBlends|attention` presses a row; both need a library bound to PicPlace.
